name: inky-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for the INKY email security External API: teams, usage, message search, threat statistics, reported mail, allow/block lists, VIPs and admins.
long_description: Gives AI assistants read-only access to an INKY estate for everyday MSP email-security investigations: find a customer's team, search the analysis records of inbound mail by recipient, sender or Message-ID, summarise threat trends, review the reported-mail queue, and audit allow/block lists, VIPs and console admins. Uses the INKY External API with a console-issued API key in the EU or US region.

inky_api_key.title: INKY API key
inky_api_key.description: Console-issued INKY API key (Settings -> API Keys), starting with inky_ext_.

inky_region.title: INKY region
inky_region.description: eu (api.eu.inkyphishfence.com) or us (api.inkyphishfence.com). A key only works in its own region.
